policy: This is an audit ledger, not an arbitrary release blocker. Missing coverage is reported and then converted into executable regression cases. CI must fail on an actual incorrect expected surface form, unresolved placeholder, or contradictory lexical/rule output. Mark an article verified only after its applicable subparagraphs, boundary/negative cases, and interactions have source-backed executable tests; do not impose a fixed number of cases where the rule's scope does not warrant it.
